have h_main : SwapSimultaneous_postcond (X) (Y) (SwapSimultaneous (X) (Y) h_precond) h_precond := by
    simp [SwapSimultaneous, SwapSimultaneous_precond, SwapSimultaneous_postcond, Prod.ext_iff]
    <;>
    (try tauto) <;>
    (try aesop) <;>
    (try
      {
        intro h
        simp_all [ne_eq, Prod.ext_iff]
        <;>
        aesop
      }) <;>
    (try
      {
        by_cases h : X = Y <;> simp_all [ne_eq, Prod.ext_iff]
        <;>
        aesop
      })
    <;>
    aesop
  exact h_main
